mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.resource_id, r.reservation_date, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.expire_at, r.timeout_message_sent, r.reserve_type, r.status, r.create_time, r.confirm_time, r.complete_time, r.cancel_time, r.update_time FROM tb_reservation r INNER JOIN ( SELECT id FROM tb_reservation FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize} ) page_ids ON r.id = page_ids.id ORDER BY page_ids.id DESC
SELECT id FROM tb_resource WHERE id = #{resourceId} AND status = 1 FOR UPDATE
